item.title: SEC fines Myloan Lending Investors anew for unfair debt collection practices
item.description: The Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) has directed Myloan Lending Investors, Inc. to stop employing humiliating, coercive, or third-party pressure tactics in its collection activities, in accordance with the Commission’s rules against unfair debt collection practices.
